many people already turn against it.

Well? Do you think you can follow my theory?

Well, it can't be helped.
Once you feel you can follow it, I'll tell you the rest.

en: At least you didn't laugh. That's something.
In fact, I have a theory ready that cannot
go on without grasping "the unconscious."
There is a doorway to the unconscious,
which we normally cannot even approach.
That doorway is "the dream."
"The dream"?
Yes. Surely you have them too.
The things we see while we sleep.
Presenting this theory should bring new
developments to neurology as well.
During sleep, when consciousness fades,
the unconscious tries to fulfill some wish,
just as it does with slips of the tongue.
Yes, just as with slips of the tongue.
Will you be presenting it at this conference?
Claude.
What brings you here at this hour?
I was hoping you could help me, Claude.
Do you know someone suffering from neurosis?
I can examine the person, at least, but
if it is a neurosis, I cannot treat
it. Is that still all right?
No,
it isn't someone else. It's about me.
Very well. Tell me about it, then.
The truth is

en: and that's how it is.
I've never seen a case like this.
So you're plagued by the obsessive belief
that you are a vampire
It isn't an obsession. It's a fact.
S-stop it

en: Stop fooling around
Waaaaah
What you saw once you became a Nosferatu
was no dream. It is a fact.
So you suspect me too, huh?
What on earth are you talking about?
Don't play dumb. You came here thinking
I'm the murderer too, didn't ya?
Like I told the police time and again, I've
got nothing whatsoever to do with the case.
Please... ya gotta believe me.
I ain't the killer.
I ain't Jack, I tell ya!!
Oh, it's you.
Sorry I lost my head the other day.
Like I keep saying, I ain't Jack
or anything of the sort.
Sure, cutting hides with a blade is
my trade, so I'm used to it, but
human skin? Don't be ridiculous!
Truth is, I saw what looked like Jack.
I really did.
Right around the time of the murder, too.
I was nice enough to tell the police, and
they turned around and suspected me!
Honestly, this city's police are useless.
See, I happened to spot a guy in a black
cloak sneakily putting away a bloody knife.
Whoever it was went tearing off
to the west at an incredible speed.
It was dark, so I couldn't make out their
shape or face at all, though.
